clauses.title: Scope – Requirements, methods
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements, methods of sampling and tests for polymethyl methacrylate (acrylic) sheets.

clauses.title: Requirements
clauses.text: 2. Requirements

clauses.title: Protection of Surface –
clauses.text: 2.1 Protection of Surface -  Unless otherwise agreed between the supplier and the purchaser, the surface of the sheet, as delivered, shall be protected by suitable material, for example, kraft paper pasted with a water soluble or pressure-sensitive adhesive or a polyethylene or any other suitable film; readily removable without surface contamination or damage.

clauses.title: Appearance
clauses.text: 2.2 Appearance

clauses.title: Surface Defects – The
clauses.text: 2.2.1 Surface Defects - The sheets shall have a smooth surface. There shall be no surface defects, scratches or marks larger than 5 mm2 each anywhere in the sheet.

clauses.title: Inclusion Defects – There
clauses.text: 2.2.2 Inclusion Defects - There shall be no bubbles, large inclusions, cracks or other defects that could adversely affect the performance of the sheet in its intended application. There shall be no foreign matter inclusions larger than 4 mm2 each anywhere in the sheet.

clauses.title: Classification of Defects
clauses.text: 2.2.3 Classification of Defects Classification Surface Defects Inclusion Defects (1) (2) (3) Negligible Less than 2 mm2 Less than 1 mm2 Acceptable 2 to 5 mm2 1 to 4 mm2

clauses.title: Distribution of Defects
clauses.text: 2.2.4 Distribution of Defects

clauses.title: There shall not be
clauses.text: 2.2.4.1 There shall not be a significant (for the application) amount of fine defects, each of which is defined as negligible in above, within 1 mm2 each anywhere in the sheet.

clauses.title: No defect defined as acceptable above
clauses.text: 2.2.4.2   No defect defined as acceptable above  shall be within 500 mm of another acceptable defect anywhere in or on the sheet.

clauses.title: Colour – The colour
clauses.text: 2.3 Colour - The colour distribution shall be homogenous, unless otherwise specified. Variations in colours shall be agreed between the purchaser and the supplier.

clauses.title: Visual Examination – The
clauses.text: 2.4 Visual Examination - The sheets shall be visually examined for scratch, air bubbles, foreign material or any other marks except such special marks which have been specified by the purchaser.

clauses.title: Dimensions
clauses.text: 2.5 Dimensions

clauses.title: The preferred dimensions, after
clauses.text: 2.5.1 The preferred dimensions, after trimming, for the supply of cast acrylic sheets shall be as follows.

clauses.title: Size I – The
clauses.text: 2.5.1.1 Size I - The sheets up to 2 m2 surface area - a) 765 × 610 mm b) 1 220 × 915 mm c) 1 220 × 1525 mm d) 1 375 × 915 mm e) 1 750 × 1140 mm f) 1 830 × 915 mm

clauses.title: Size II – The
clauses.text: 2.5.1.2 Size II - The sheets offering more that 2 m2 surface area a) 1 220 × 1 830 mm b) 1 780 × 1 180 mm c) 1 800 × 1 200 mm d) 2 170 ×1 050 mm

clauses.title: The tolerance for the
clauses.text: 2.5.1.3 The tolerance for the dimensions shall be + - 5 0 mm.

clauses.title: Thickness – The preferred thickness and
clauses.text: 2.5.2 Thickness - The preferred thickness and permissible thickness variation for the acrylic sheets be as given below : Thickness Tolerance (mm) Size I Size II (1) (2) (3) 2.0 ± 0.43 ± 0.6 2.5 ± 0.43 ± 0.6 3.0 ± 0.5 ± 0.6 4.0 ± 0.5 ± 0.7 5.0 ± 0.6 ± 0.8 6.0 ± 0.8 ± 0.9 8.0 ± 0.9 ± 1.0 10.0 ± 1.0 ± 1.1 12.0 - 13.0 ± 1.1 ± 1.3 15.0 ± 1.4 ± 1.4 18.0 ± 1.4 ± 1.4 20.0 - 25.0 ± 1.4 ± 1.4 30.0 ± 1.8 ± 1.8

clauses.title: Specific Gravity – Shall
clauses.text: 2.6 Specific Gravity - Shall not be less than 1.18 and more than 1.20.

clauses.title: Water Absorption – Shall
clauses.text: 2.7 Water Absorption - Shall not be more than 0.4 percent of the dry mass of the sample after 24 h immersion.

clauses.title: Tensile Strength and Elongation
clauses.text: 2.8 Tensile Strength and Elongation - Shall show a tensile strength of 570 kg/cm2, Min and elongation at rupture shall not be less than 4.0 percent.

clauses.title: Impact Strength – Shall
clauses.text: 2.9 Impact Strength - Shall not be less than 1.6 kg cm/ cm of the notch.

clauses.title: Rockwell Hardness – Shall
clauses.text: 2.10 Rockwell Hardness - Shall be RHM 100 ± 5.

clauses.title: Effect of Heat on
clauses.text: 2.11 Effect of Heat on Rigidity, that is Temperature of Deflection Under Load - Shall not show a defection of 0.25 mm until it reaches a temperature in excess of 850C.

clauses.title: Vicat Softening Temperature –
clauses.text: 2.12 Vicat Softening Temperature - Shall not be less than 1000C.

clauses.title: Burning Rate – Shall
clauses.text: 2.13  Burning Rate - Shall show a burning rate of not more than 40 mm per minute.

clauses.title: Refractive Index – Shall
clauses.text: 2.14  Refractive Index - Shall show a refractive index not more than 1.49.

clauses.title: Haze and Luminous Transmittance
clauses.text: 2.15 Haze and Luminous Transmittance  -  Shall show minimum transmittance of 91 percent and haze percent shall not exceed 3.

clauses.title: Stability Towards Yellowing
clauses.text: 2.16 Stability Towards Yellowing

clauses.title: Yellowness Index Method – Yellowness index
clauses.text: 2.16.1 Yellowness Index Method - Yellowness index values of PMMA sheets produced from virgin monomer MMA, colour code 001-clear transparent shall be as given below : Thickness, t          YI for Sheet        YI/t Sheet (mm) 2 3.6 to 4.2        1.80 to 2.10 2.5 3.7 to 4.3        1.8 to 1.72 3 3.8 to 4.4        1.27 to 1.47

clauses.title: Diffusion Factor and Uniformity
clauses.text: 2.17 Diffusion Factor and Uniformity of Diffusion -

clauses.title: Diffusion Factor – The
clauses.text: 2.17.1 Diffusion Factor - The diffusion factor shall be calculated as : Diffusion factor = L 2 0 + L 7 0 2 L 5 where L5, L20 and L70 are the luminance values of the surface when viewed at 5º, 20º and 70º to the normal.

clauses.title: The test sheet for
clauses.text: 2.17.2 The test sheet for uniformity of diffusion (applicable for diffusion factors between 0.85 and 0.9 shall appear to be uniformly bright.

clauses.title: Residual Monomer Test –
clauses.text: 2.18 Residual Monomer Test - Shall not exceed by more than 2 percent by mass. Note - For methods of tests, refer to Appendix A to F of the standard and relevant parts of IS 13360 Plastics Methods of testing. For detailed information, refer to IS 14753 : 1999 Specifications for polymethyl methacrylate (PMMA) (acrylic) sheets.
